newsitem.title: TURKEY: Abana to build new production plant.
newsitem.headline: Abana to build new production plant.

text.p: Turkish street-light armature, electric counter and remote counter system producer Abana Elektromekanik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. will build a production and maintenance plant in Turkey's western town of Izmit, a company official said.
"Construction will begin this year," accounting manager Feyzi Kose told Reuters.
Kose said the company would produce electric power consumption counters, remote counters, armatures and other electric system instruments at the plant which will also be used for maintenance.
Abana's sister company, Ar Insaat A.S., will undertake the construction, expected to be completed by the end of this year.
"Production at the new plant will probably begin in early 1998," Kose said.

The company now operates in a rented building in Istanbul where it will begin in May to produce aluminium street-light armatures for Aktas Elektrik Ticaret A.S., another sister company and the sole power distributer on the Asian side of Istanbul.
Abana and Aktas had signed a contract in December for the modernisation of electric counters and production and installation of remote control counter systems and related instruments.
